role: Explosion fuzz probe: runs WorldServer.newExplosion's body (doExplosionA, doExplosionB(false)) over a raw region scattered with every resistance class, with items and orbs in the blast, recording affected positions in HashSet order, fire placements, block writes, spawned drops, entity after-states and RNG states.
used_by: oracle/Makefile run target (make run CLASS=ExplosionProbe), dispatched by Oracle.java's {"cmd":"run","class":...}
notes: Spawns entities the way EntityProbe does and seeds each case's world Random the way DropsProbe does. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
